NewsArticle.Title: Chaos Entering Temuair
NewsArticle.Content: The Druids of Temuair are working hard on the recent infestation of vipers into the lands. All points to the sudden appearance of a Monolith in a previous unknown cavern within the Pravat Caves. They hope to have a solution to the destruction of this abomination in the very near future. But will its death bring freedom or something even worse?
